nodes.label: 4α-carboxyzymosterol
props: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4α-carboxyzymosterol, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

nodes.label: 4α-methylzymosterol
props: A 3β-sterol that is  zymosterol substituted by a 4α-methyl group.

nodes.label: 3-keto-4α-methylzymosterol
props: A 3-dehydro-4-methylzymosterol in which the methyl substituent at position 4 has α configuration. It is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of cholesterol.

nodes.label: 4α-carboxy-4β-methylzymosterol
props: A 3β-sterol that consists of 4β-methylzymosterol in which the 4α-hydrogen is replaced by a carboxy group.

nodes.label: 14-dimethyllanosterol
props: A 3β-sterol formed formally by loss of a methyl group from the 14-position of lanosterol.

nodes.label: lanosterol
props: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanosta-8,24-diene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at the 3β position. It is the compound from which all steroids are derived.

nodes.label: NSDHL
props: Catalyzes the NAD(P)(+)-dependent oxidative decarboxylation of the C4 methyl groups of 4-alpha-carboxysterols in post-squalene cholesterol biosynthesis. Also plays a role in the regulation of the endocytic trafficking of EGFR

nodes.label: MSMO1
props: Catalyzes the three-step monooxygenation required for the demethylation of 4,4-dimethyl and 4alpha-methylsterols, which can be subsequently metabolized to cholesterol. Also involved in drug metabolism, as it can metabolize eldecalcitol (ED-71 or 1alpha,25-dihydroxy-2beta-(3-hydroxypropoxy)-cholecalciferol), a second-generation vitamin D analog, into 1alpha,2beta,25-trihydroxy vitamin D3; this reaction occurs via enzymatic hydroxylation and spontaneous O-dehydroxypropylation

nodes.label: TM7SF2
props: 3-beta-hydroxysterol Delta (14)-reductase; Another new gene 1 protein; C-14 sterol reductase; Putative sterol reductase SR-1; Sterol C14-reductase; Transmembrane 7 superfamily member 2
Catalyzes the reduction of the C14-unsaturated bond of lanosterol, as part of the metabolic pathway leading to cholesterol biosynthesis

nodes.label: CYP51A1
props: CYPLI; Cytochrome P450 51A1; Cytochrome P450-14DM; Cytochrome P450LI; Sterol 14-alpha demethylase

Sterol 14alpha-demethylase that plays a critical role in the cholesterol biosynthesis pathway, being cholesterol the major sterol component in mammalian membranes as well as a precursor for bile acid and steroid hormone synthesis. Cytochrome P450 monooxygenase that catalyzes the three-step oxidative removal of the 14alpha-methyl group (C-32) of sterols such as lanosterol (lanosta-8,24-dien-3beta-ol) and 24,25-dihydrolanosterol (DHL) in the form of formate, and converts the sterols to 4,4-dimethyl-5alpha-cholesta-8,14,24-trien-3beta-ol and 4,4-dimethyl-8,14-cholestadien-3beta-ol, respectively, which are intermediates of cholesterol biosynthesis.

nodes.label: LSS
props: Key enzyme in the cholesterol biosynthesis pathway. Catalyzes the cyclization of (S)-2,3 oxidosqualene to lanosterol, a reaction that forms the sterol nucleus.

nodes.label: 2,3:22,23-dioxidosqualene
props: A squalene triterpenoid obtained by epoxidation accross the 2,3- and 22,23-double bonds of squalene.

nodes.label: squalene-2,3-epoxide
props: A 2,3-epoxysqualene in which the chiral centre has S configuration. It is converted into lanosterol by lanosterol synthase (EC 5.4.99.7) in a key rate-limiting step in the biosynthesis of chloesterol, steroid hormones, and vitamin D.

nodes.label: DHCR24
props: Catalyzes the reduction of the delta-24 double bond of sterol intermediates during cholesterol biosynthesis. In addition to its cholesterol-synthesizing activity, can protect cells from oxidative stress by reducing caspase 3 activity during apoptosis induced by oxidative stress.
Endoplasmic reticulum membrane, Golgi apparatus membrane

nodes.label: SQLE
props: Catalyzes the stereospecific oxidation of squalene to (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene, and is considered to be a rate-limiting enzyme in steroid biosynthesis

nodes.label: 4,4-dimethyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A cholestanoid that is 5α-cholesta-8-en-3β-ol bearing two additional methyl substituents at position 4.

nodes.label: 7-dehydrodesmosterol
props: A 3β-sterol having the structure of desmosterol with an extra double bond at C-7—C-8.

nodes.label: desmosterol
props: A cholestanoid that is cholesta-5,24-diene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3. It is an intermediate metabolite obtained during the synthesis of cholesterol.

nodes.label: NSDHL
props: Catalyzes the NAD(P)(+)-dependent oxidative decarboxylation of the C4 methyl groups of 4-alpha-carboxysterols in post-squalene cholesterol biosynthesis. Also plays a role in the regulation of the endocytic trafficking of EGFR

nodes.label: MSMO1
props: Catalyzes the three-step monooxygenation required for the demethylation of 4,4-dimethyl and 4alpha-methylsterols, which can be subsequently metabolized to cholesterol. Also involved in drug metabolism, as it can metabolize eldecalcitol (ED-71 or 1alpha,25-dihydroxy-2beta-(3-hydroxypropoxy)-cholecalciferol), a second-generation vitamin D analog, into 1alpha,2beta,25-trihydroxy vitamin D3; this reaction occurs via enzymatic hydroxylation and spontaneous O-dehydroxypropylation

nodes.label: HSD17B7
props: 17-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase 7; 3-keto-steroid reductase; Dihydrotestosterone oxidoreductase; Estradiol 17-beta-dehydrogenase 7; Short chain dehydrogenase/reductase family 37C member 1

Bifunctional enzyme involved in steroid-hormone metabolism and cholesterol biosynthesis. Catalyzes the NADP(H)-dependent reduction of estrogens and androgens and regulates the biological potency of these steroids.

nodes.label: HSD17B7
props: 17-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase 7; 3-keto-steroid reductase; Dihydrotestosterone oxidoreductase; Estradiol 17-beta-dehydrogenase 7; Short chain dehydrogenase/reductase family 37C member 1

Bifunctional enzyme involved in steroid-hormone metabolism and cholesterol biosynthesis. Catalyzes the NADP(H)-dependent reduction of estrogens and androgens and regulates the biological potency of these steroids.

nodes.label: EBP
props: Cholestenol Delta-isomerase; Cholesterol-5,6-epoxide hydrolase subunit EBP; Delta(8)-Delta(7) sterol isomerase; Emopamil-binding protein
Isomerase that catalyzes the conversion of Delta(8)-sterols to their corresponding Delta(7)-isomers a catalytic step in the postlanosterol biosynthesis of cholesterol
Endoplasmic reticulum membrane, Nucleus envelope, Cytoplasmic vesicle

nodes.label: SC5D
props: C-5 sterol desaturase; Delta(7)-sterol 5-desaturase; Delta(7)-sterol C5(6)-desaturase; Lathosterol 5-desaturase; Sterol-C5-desaturase

Catalyzes the penultimate step of the biosynthesis of cholesterol, the dehydrogenation of lathosterol into 7-dehydrocholesterol (7-DHC). Cholesterol is the major sterol component in mammalian membranes and a precursor for bile acid and steroid hormone synthesis.

nodes.label: DHCR7
props: Delta7-sterol reductase; Sterol Delta(7)-reductase; Sterol reductase SR-2

Oxidoreductase that catalyzes the last step of the cholesterol synthesis pathway, which transforms cholesta-5,7-dien-3beta-ol (7-dehydrocholesterol,7-DHC) into cholesterol by reducing the C7-C8 double bond of its sterol core. Can also metabolize cholesta-5,7,24-trien-3beta-ol (7-dehydrodemosterol, 7-DHD) to desmosterol, which is then metabolized by the Delta(24)-sterol reductase (DHCR24) to cholesterol.

nodes.label: cholesterol
props: A cholestanoid consisting of cholestane having a double bond at the 5,6-position as well as a 3β-hydroxy group.

nodes.label: DHCR24
props: Catalyzes the reduction of the delta-24 double bond of sterol intermediates during cholesterol biosynthesis. In addition to its cholesterol-synthesizing activity, can protect cells from oxidative stress by reducing caspase 3 activity during apoptosis induced by oxidative stress.
Endoplasmic reticulum membrane, Golgi apparatus membrane

nodes.label: 24(S),25-epoxycholesterol
props: A 3β-hydroxy-Δ5-steroid that is desmosterol in which the double bond at position 24-25 has been oxidised to the corresponding epoxide (the 24S diastereoisomer). It is an oxysterol agonist of the liver X receptor.

nodes.label: lathosterol
props: A cholestanoid that is (5α)-cholest-7-ene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3.

nodes.label: 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A cholestanoid that is 5α-cholestane substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3.

nodes.label: 4α-carboxy-5α-cholesta-8-en-3β-ol
props: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying an additional carboxy substituent at position 4α.

nodes.label: 5α-cholest-8-en-3-one
props: A cholestanoid that is 5α-cholest-8-ene substituted at position 3 by an oxo group.

nodes.label: 4α-methyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying an additional methyl substituent at position 4α.

nodes.label: 4α-methyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-one
props: A 3-oxo steroid that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3-one carrying an additional methyl substituent at position 4α.

nodes.label: 4α-carboxy-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying carboxy and methyl substituents at position 4.

nodes.label: squalene
props: A triterpene consisting of 2,6,10,15,19,23-hexamethyltetracosane having six double bonds at the 2-, 6-, 10-, 14-, 18- and 22-positions with (all-E)-configuration.

nodes.label: 4α-formyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-dien-3β-ol
props: A 4-formylzymosterol in which the formyl group at position 4 has α-configuration.

nodes.label: 4α-hydroxymethyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-dien-3β-ol
props: A 4-hydroxymethylzymosterol in which the hydroxymethyl group at position 4 has α-configuration.

nodes.label: 4α-formyl-5α-cholesta-8-en-3β-ol
props: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying an additional formyl substituent at position 4α.

nodes.label: 4,4-dimethyl-14α-formyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanost-8-ene carrying hydroxy and oxo substituents at positions 3β and 30 respectively.

nodes.label: 4,4-dimethyl-14α-hydroxymethyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanost-8-ene carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 3β and 30.

nodes.label: 4α-formyl-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying formyl and methyl substituents at position 4.

nodes.label: 4α-hydroxymethyl-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
props: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying hydroxymethyl and methyl substituents at position 4.

nodes.label: 24-hydroxycholesterol
props: A 24-hydroxycholesterol that has S configuration at position 24. It is the major metabolic breakdown product of cholesterol in the brain.

nodes.label: 4β-hydroxycholesterol
props: A oxysterol that is cholesterol in which the hydrogen at the 4β position has been replaced by a hydroxy group. A metabolite of cholesterol formed by the drug-metabolizing enzyme cytochrome P450 3A4, it is one of the major oxysterols in the human circulation.

nodes.label: CYP3A4
props: 1,4-cineole 2-exo-monooxygenase; 1,8-cineole 2-exo-monooxygenase; Albendazole monooxygenase (sulfoxide-forming); Albendazole sulfoxidase; CYPIIIA3; CYPIIIA4; Cholesterol 25-hydroxylase; Cytochrome P450 3A3; Cytochrome P450 HLp; Cytochrome P450 NF-25; Cytochrome P450-PCN1; Nifedipine oxidase; Quinine 3-monooxygenase

A cytochrome P450 monooxygenase involved in the metabolism of sterols, steroid hormones, retinoids and fatty acids. Mechanistically, uses molecular oxygen inserting one oxygen atom into a substrate, and reducing the second into a water molecule, with two electrons provided by NADPH via cytochrome P450 reductase (NADPH--hemoprotein reductase).

nodes.label: CH25H
props: Catalyzes the formation of 25-hydroxycholesterol from cholesterol, leading to repress cholesterol biosynthetic enzymes. Plays a key role in cell positioning and movement in lymphoid tissues: 25-hydroxycholesterol is an intermediate in biosynthesis of 7-alpha,25-dihydroxycholesterol (7-alpha,25-OHC), an oxysterol that acts as a ligand for the G protein-coupled receptor GPR183/EBI2, a chemotactic receptor for a number of lymphoid cells.

nodes.label: CYP7A1
props: A cytochrome P450 monooxygenase involved in the metabolism of endogenous cholesterol and its oxygenated derivatives (oxysterols). Mechanistically, uses molecular oxygen inserting one oxygen atom into a substrate, and reducing the second into a water molecule, with two electrons provided by NADPH via cytochrome P450 reductase (CPR; NADPH-ferrihemoprotein reductase).

nodes.label: CYP46A1
props: P450 monooxygenase that plays a major role in cholesterol homeostasis in the brain. Primarily catalyzes the hydroxylation (with S stereochemistry) at C-24 of cholesterol side chain, triggering cholesterol diffusion out of neurons and its further degradation.
Endoplasmic reticulum membrane, Microsome membrane, Postsynapse, Presynapse, Cell projection, dendrite

nodes.label: cholesterol
props: A cholestanoid consisting of cholestane having a double bond at the 5,6-position as well as a 3β-hydroxy group.

nodes.label: 27-hydroxycholesterol
props: A 26-hydroxycholesterol in which the 25-position has R-configuration.

nodes.label: CYP27A1
props: 5-beta-cholestane-3-alpha,7-alpha,12-alpha-triol 26-hydroxylase; Cytochrome P-450C27/25; Cytochrome P450 27; Sterol 27-hydroxylase; Vitamin D(3) 25-hydroxylase

Cytochrome P450 monooxygenase that catalyzes regio- and stereospecific hydroxylation of cholesterol and its derivatives. Hydroxylates (with R stereochemistry) the terminal methyl group of cholesterol side-chain in a three step reaction to yield at first a C26 alcohol, then a C26 aldehyde and finally a C26 acid.
